sermon.title: Jesus Went Faithfully to Church 05/05/2019
sermon.series: Why Jesus Is Important to All Mankind
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Jesus went faithfully to the synagogue and read the Scriptures. He urges believers to read the Bible, go where truth is preached, and work at home and church. Jesus was anointed to heal the brokenhearted, free captives and restore sight, and the acceptable year of the Lord is now.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Young people in the congregation are addressed by first name near the end (37:48); names kept in the transcript only.
